backend.basis: SEG-072 hardware benchmark (ROCm 8.9% faster than the 8-process CPU farm, below its 25% rule); research venv rebuilt at the recorded versions (Python 3.13.14, numpy 2.5.3, scikit-learn 1.9.1, torch 2.14.1+cu130 on CPU, float32, deterministic algorithms)
backend.parallelism: M3_R 4 processes x 4 threads; M4_DENSE 8 processes x 2 threads; M1 2 processes

barrier.rule: development, tuning and selection tooling refuses the sealed directory, every sealed sample id and every reserved lineage; the binding holds opaque digests only; the sealed labels are opened once by T006 after the frozen candidate is committed

budgets.training_effort: every fit uses its unchanged SEG-072 recipe (epochs/steps/seeds/batch); conditions differ only in the training image list

ordering.condition: each configuration in its best transfer condition (C2 if its class is HELPS or NEUTRAL, else C0)
ordering.rule: a configuration's development record = (genesis B50 misses summed over lineages, genesis mean ER, xplat_lolo mean ER, complexity); candidates are compared lexicographically: fewer B50 misses; then lower genesis mean ER unless within tau (treated equal); then lower xplat_lolo mean ER unless within tau; then the simpler configuration

t005_scope.code_binding: the A/B/C implementation files are written after this freeze and are bound by digest in a T005 pre-fit addendum (segarecomp_xplat_design.t005.json, committed and reviewed before any A/B/C fit)
t005_scope.condition: models A/B/C train on C2 unless the T004 overall class is TRANSFER_HARMS (then C0); same genesis_lolo and xplat_lolo folds as T004; no hyper-parameter search (fixed configurations below) - nothing is tuned on the folds compared
t005_scope.model_A: always built: sklearn HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_iter=300, max_depth=6, learning_rate=0.05, min_samples_leaf=40, l2_regularization=1.0, max_bins=255, early_stopping=False, class_weight=balanced, random_state=49) over per-cell features: counts per token field value (status/length/family/control/ea_src/ea_dst/width/flags) over the cell's words; ordinary-decode chain features (longest chain of consecutive ordinary decodes following decoder lengths starting in the cell; number of chain starts); direct control-flow candidates (branch/call targets computed from the opcode displacement or absolute operand of ordinary direct-control decodes: count landing in the image on an ordinary decode, count landing in this cell from anywhere); byte context (zero-byte fraction, printable-ASCII fraction, byte-value entropy); relocation-field count in the cell (0 for Genesis); seed-cell flag; the same aggregates over the +/-1 and +/-4 neighbour cells; masked cells excluded from training
t005_scope.model_B: built only if the ordering's best of {M1_HGB, A, M3_R, M4_DENSE} has genesis mean ER >= 0.10 AND T004 is not EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT: a bounded local instruction-aware Transformer: per-word input = embed(hi byte) + embed(lo byte) + the M3/M4 decode-token embeddings, d_model 64, 2 encoder layers, 4 heads, feed-forward 128, learned positions, attention restricted to non-overlapping 256-word windows with 64 words of real context (or PAD) on each side; per-word logit -> cell max (M4 aggregation); training exactly M4's budget and recipe (4000 steps, batch 8, AdamW lr 0.002 x0.1 after 80%, weight decay 1e-4, masked BCE with M4's pos_weight, lineage-uniform sampling, seeds 1-3 averaged)
t005_scope.model_C: built only if B is better than A by the ordering with genesis mean ER lower by >= tau: B plus 2 rounds of typed sparse message passing per encoder layer over edges within the window+context: fall-through (ordinary decode -> next position by decoder length), direct branch / call target (computed as for A), overlapping interpretation (positions inside a decoded instruction's extent), each typed separately as CANDIDATE edges, plus a node flag for positions statically reachable from seed roots by fall-through and direct edges (PROVEN); hypothetical edges never mark a position reachable; same training budget as B
t005_scope.preference: the ordering rule (simpler wins within tau and without extra misses)

t006.confident_starts: the I-labelled starts of the sealed samples (ADR 0160 labels; U never counts as a miss)
t006.credibility: LIMITED: two reserved lineages (platform held-out Neo Geo, its GCC 13 compiler family is in training via toslibc; compiler held-out vbcc, object-only, small, shares vasm and the Atari ST platform with training); descriptive cross-platform evidence; no Genesis generalization claim
t006.economics: economic measure = complete budget: the smallest of B35/B50/B60 whose genesis_lolo B-misses summed over all 11 lineages are <= the M3_R seed-replicate allowance sum (sum a_l); a candidate is economically better than the comparator C0 M3_R iff its complete budget is smaller (retained cells -30%/-17%); when it is, the SEG-074 exact-code benchmark (tools/segarecomp_oracle_bench.py, unchanged) measures generated C bytes and compile CPU on the Genesis development images it supports, at both budgets, and the improvement is confirmed only if generated C falls by >= 10% AND compile CPU by >= 10% (SEG-072's incumbent gate); never run on the reserved cross-platform lineages
t006.evaluated_samples: every sealed sample with >= 1 labelled start (all of them, not only representatives - no reserved image trains); ER over informative samples; misses over all samples; per reserved lineage
t006.freeze: before the sealed labels are opened: the ordering's best configuration (+ its condition) as the candidate, budget policy B50, and the comparators M3_FROZEN and C0-all M3_R+B50 are written to segarecomp_xplat_design.frozen.json and committed
t006.one_shot: the frozen candidate and comparators are refit on all development data of their condition (fold 'all'), then score the sealed reserved samples once; a one-shot marker is written to the private sealed directory; a second run refuses
outcome_rule: 2 contradiction: the one-shot contradicts the candidate if, on any reserved lineage, it misses more confident starts at B50 than the C0 M3_R comparator, or its reserved mean ER exceeds the comparator's by > tau; a contradicted candidate cannot carry classes 3-6
3 CORPUS_IMPROVES_EXISTING: candidate is M1_HGB/M3_R/M4_DENSE trained on C1/C2, ordered better than C0 M3_R, economically better (confirmed), not contradicted

4 LIGHTWEIGHT_STRUCTURAL_JUSTIFIED / 5 LOCAL_TRANSFORMER_JUSTIFIED / 6 GRAPH_TRANSFORMER_JUSTIFIED: candidate is A / B / C, ordered better than C0 M3_R, economically better (confirmed), not contradicted
7 NO_ECONOMIC_IMPROVEMENT: a candidate is ordered better than C0 M3_R but is not economically better (or the benchmark does not confirm), or it is contradicted
8 CORPUS_EXPANSION_ONLY: no candidate is ordered better than C0 M3_R on Genesis, but C2 improves xplat_lolo mean ER over C0-all by >= tau for M3_R
rules apply in order; exactly one class; no production model is promoted

transfer.TRANSFER_HARMS: d_mean >= +tau OR any d_l > +2*tau OR any e_l > 0
transfer.TRANSFER_HELPS: d_mean <= -tau AND every d_l <= +tau AND every e_l = 0
transfer.overall: the class of C2 under M3_R (primary model, matched to SEG-072's frozen selection); M4_DENSE, M1_HGB and C1 corroborate; Amiga attribution (C1 vs C2) relies on M4_DENSE (M3_R's cross-platform segments are dominated by EmuTOS)
transfer.per_model: for M3_R, M4_DENSE@128, M4_DENSE@64 and M1_HGB, compare C2 (and C1 where fitted) with C0 on genesis_lolo; d_l = ER_l(Cx) - ER_l(C0), d_mean = mean over lineages; e_l = max(0, misses_B50_l(Cx) - misses_B50_l(C0) - a_l)

dedup.rule: within a lineage, greedy largest-first: an image whose instruction sequences are >= 0.5 contained in the kept images is a near-duplicate; only representatives train; near-duplicates are diagnostic only

folds.genesis_lolo: leave-one-lineage-out over the 11 qualified SEG-072 development lineages (all 50 images); the held-out Genesis lineage is scored; the condition's cross-platform development representatives are added to every training set
folds.xplat_lolo: for each cross-platform development lineage x: C2-minus-x (Genesis + the other three) versus C0-all (Genesis only), both scoring the representatives of x; this measures transfer to an unseen cross-platform lineage

genesis.restored: the 36 Sonic CD modules (lineage D01) referenced by the SEG-072 registry were restored from the operator's disc image (ISO 9660 files of track 1); every restored file equals the SHA-256 the SEG-072 handoff bundle recorded
genesis.source: SEG-072 qualified development registry (ADR 0152), images physically available at freeze
genesis.unavailable_rule: an image that is unavailable at freeze is excluded from EVERY condition (including C0, then retrained), so comparisons stay matched

BattleIsleEditor.rationale: six editor variants of one author's code base; near-duplicates reduced to representatives

HelloAmi.rationale: 82 labelled starts in total: too small to be a training or evaluation lineage

amiga-realtime3d.rationale: nine incremental programs of one tutorial code base; one representative

emutos.rationale: one firmware lineage (four configurations); one representative image, the other configurations are near-duplicates (diagnostic only); counted as Atari ST (its primary platform) in every condition

neogeosdk.fractions: sealed (quality checked at freeze: decoder agreement and U fraction within the gate)
neogeosdk.rationale: platform held-out: the only Neo Geo lineage (never in any training or selection condition)

space-invaders.fractions: sealed (quality checked at freeze: decoder agreement and U fraction within the gate)
space-invaders.rationale: compiler held-out: the only vbcc lineage (object-only, small)

toslibc.rationale: Atari ST C runtime library + examples (GCC 13.3); training material in conditions C1/C2

metrics.aggregation: per lineage first, then mean over lineages (no image- or start-weighted pooling across lineages; EmuTOS counts once in metrics - in M3_R training it dominates the cross-platform segments, see disclosure)
metrics.co_primary: worst-lineage ER (max over the 11 Genesis lineages)
metrics.er: excess retention ER(image) = (cells_needed - positive_cells) / (cells - positive_cells), cells_needed = the FRF cell count (rank order, ties with the weakest positive counted), 128-byte cells (M4@64: 64-byte); the fraction of the non-positive cells that must be retained to keep every labelled start; 0 = perfect ranking, 1 = no better than retaining everything
metrics.informative: an image is informative iff it has >= 1 positive and >= 1 non-positive cell; ER is defined on informative images only; the number of trivial (all-positive or no-positive) images per lineage is reported
metrics.primary: Genesis transfer: mean over the 11 Genesis lineages of the per-lineage max ER over its informative held-out images
metrics.retained: retained fraction = retained cells / cells (cell units; SEG-072 reported cells too for policies)
secondary: FRF (reported, not decisive; degenerate on all-positive images)
per-lineage B35/B50/B60 misses (labelled starts outside R; false negatives) and negative (all-D) cells admitted (false positives), reported separately
short/mixed stratum: positive cells holding <= 8 starts or any D byte (missed cells)
xplat_lolo: mean / worst ER and misses over the four cross-platform lineages
per toolchain family and per platform
metrics.seeds: seed cells come from seed ADDRESSES (Genesis: the SEG-072 registry d.txt / seed_starts; cross-platform: meta seed_addresses), mapped address // cell_bytes for each cell size

models.C0_reuse: condition C0 genesis_lolo fold scores ARE the preserved SEG-072 development fold scores (M3R / M4 s1-s3 / M1; same images, recipes and environment), admitted only when `reproduce` retrained one fold of EACH of M3_R, M4_DENSE seed 1 and M1_HGB under this plan digest and all three equal the preserved arrays bit for bit (reproduce.json); otherwise every C0 fold is retrained; the runner refuses reuse without a passing reproduce.json
models.M1_HGB: SEG-072 M1 control (HistGradientBoosting over the gen2 aggregates, random_state 49), all conditions
models.M3_FROZEN: production gen2 M3 weights, unchanged: zero-shot reference on every Genesis development image (SEG-072's stored scores) and every cross-platform development representative (inference)
models.M3_R: SEG-072 M3-R recipe unchanged (seed 49, 30 epochs), all conditions; condition C0 additionally with seed 50 (noise replicate)
models.M4_DENSE: SEG-072 M4-Dense recipe unchanged (seeds 1-3, word logits averaged then cell max at 128 and 64 bytes), conditions C0 and C2

noise.disclosure: one seed pair; conservative (biased toward NEUTRAL/HARMS); fits are deterministic, so tau is not adjustable
noise.insufficient_if: tau > 0.05, or any planned fit missing / failed twice (the table then classifies EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT)
noise.miss_allowance: a_l = |misses_B50_l(seed 49) - misses_B50_l(seed 50)| per Genesis lineage l (M3_R, C0); applied to every model
noise.tau: tau = max(0.01, 2 * mean over the 11 Genesis lineages of |ER_l(M3_R C0 seed 49) - ER_l(M3_R C0 seed 50)|)

seg072_sealed_cohort: exposed by SEG-072: development/diagnostic only, never fresh evidence

supersedes.reason: C3 review (APPROVE_WITH_CONDITIONS, before any fit): FRF degenerate on all-positive images (ER adopted), B50 miss rule without noise allowance, open selection/economics/outcome choices, runner not bound to the plan, C0 reuse not gated, representatives omitted images without an 8-instruction run
